---
title: "Quality: Improve mobile and tablet training layouts"
labels: "enhancement,roadmap,priority:P2,area:ux"
---

## Goal

Make short study and interview sessions comfortable on tablets and phones while
preserving the dense desktop incident workspace.

## Acceptance criteria

- Replace the fixed sidebar with an accessible mobile drill drawer.
- Keep mode navigation usable without horizontal overflow.
- Make terminal controls, suggestions, and forms touch-friendly.
- Preserve readable topology with horizontal scrolling or a compact layout.
- Keep timers and score indicators visible during long responses.
- Test common phone, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
- Avoid hiding symptoms, objectives, debriefs, or grading details.
- Add Playwright visual checks for representative viewport sizes.
